definitions.gloss: lining cloth; backing fabric; lining material
definitions.explanation: Fabric used as the inner layer of a garment or textile product. Covers the inside of clothing to hide seams and provide comfort against the skin.

examples.japanese: {裏布|うらぬの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{縫|ぬ}い{付|つ}ける。
examples.english: To sew on the lining cloth.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧ (back, reverse, inside) and ⟦{布|ぬの}→布：01489_nuno⟧ (cloth, fabric). Used primarily in sewing and handicraft contexts. While ⟦{裏地|うらじ}→裏地：07101_uraji⟧ is the more common term for lining in general clothing and fashion, {裏布|うらぬの} specifically emphasizes the physical piece of cloth used as lining material, and is especially common in sewing patterns and DIY craft instructions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {裏布|うらぬの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{縫|ぬ}い{付|つ}ける: to sew on the lining
- {裏布|うらぬの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{裁断|さいだん}→裁断：19992_saidan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to cut the lining fabric
- {裏布|うらぬの}⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧: with lining
- {裏布|うらぬの}なし: without lining; unlined

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{裏地|うらじ}→裏地：07101_uraji⟧: lining — the more common general term for garment lining
- ⟦{表地|おもてじ}→表地：25005_omoteji⟧: outer fabric — the visible exterior fabric, the counterpart to lining
- {接着芯|せっちゃくしん}: fusible interfacing — a stiff material ironed onto fabric for structure
